content.description: The Web3 ecosystem is brimming with creative energy. With over 100 million NFTs and a burgeoning NFT art movement, the Monet Society is determined to further stimulate the space, help onboard and promote creators that are serious about creating by incentivizing their collectors with Monet tokens. The Monet Society distributes Monet to creative industry initiatives, including projects and platforms developing and facilitating digital art, NFTs, and Web3 technologies such as wallets, marketplaces, creator tools, and platforms for viewing and experiencing.
content.meta: Find out about The Monet Society (MONET) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
